Accordion

Collapsible sections (WAI-ARIA accordion pattern); one open at a time, or several with multiple.

Variants
default No. ray build --native makes a single binary; ray run uses the VM for quick iterations. macOS, Linux and Windows on the desktop; iOS and Android through ray bundle. Yes: ray new app --frontend react-ts, then the @ray-ds/react wrappers.
contained No. ray build --native makes a single binary; ray run uses the VM for quick iterations. macOS, Linux and Windows on the desktop; iOS and Android through ray bundle. Yes: ray new app --frontend react-ts, then the @ray-ds/react wrappers.
separated No. ray build --native makes a single binary; ray run uses the VM for quick iterations. macOS, Linux and Windows on the desktop; iOS and Android through ray bundle. Yes: ray new app --frontend react-ts, then the @ray-ds/react wrappers.
filled No. ray build --native makes a single binary; ray run uses the VM for quick iterations. macOS, Linux and Windows on the desktop; iOS and Android through ray bundle. Yes: ray new app --frontend react-ts, then the @ray-ds/react wrappers.
